translation_english: If one claims greatness, there is no lack of praises for the Lord. (Composition in Gauri by Guru Amar Das Ji)

gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਇਕੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਸੋ ਮੈ ਵਿਸਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
translation_english: The One Lord is the Giver of all beings; may I never forget Him. (Composition in Asa by Guru Ram Das Ji)

gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ॥
translation_english: The mind contemplates the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. (Composition in Gujri by Guru Arjan Dev Ji)

gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
translation_english: One Universal Creator God, The Name Is Truth, Creative Being Personified, No Fear, No Hatred, Image Of The Undying, Beyond Birth, Self-Existent, By Guru's Grace. (Composition in Sorath by Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji)

gurmukhi: ਸੋਚੈ ਸੋਚਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਜੇ ਸੋਚੀ ਲਖ ਵਾਰ ॥
translation_english: By thinking, He cannot be reduced to thought, even by thinking hundreds of thousands of times. (Composition in Dhanasri by Bhagat Kabir Ji)

gurmukhi: ਚੁਪੈ ਚੁਪ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਜੇ ਲਾਇ ਰਹਾ ਲਿਵ ਤਾਰ ॥
translation_english: By remaining silent, inner silence is not obtained, even by remaining lovingly attuned forever. (Composition in Jaitsri by Bhagat Namdev Ji)

gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਹੁਕਮ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
translation_english: Everyone is subject to His Command; no one is beyond His Command. (Composition in Todi by Bhagat Ravidas Ji)

gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮੈ ਜੇ ਬੁਝੈ ਤ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਹੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
translation_english: O Nanak, one who understands His Command does not speak in ego. (Composition in Bairari by Guru Nanak Dev Ji)

gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਤਿ ਸਰੂਪੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਬਣੀਐ ॥
translation_english: The Word of the True Guru is the embodiment of Truth; through Gurbani, one becomes true. (Composition in Tilang by Guru Amar Das Ji)

gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
translation_english: The humble servant of the Lord sings the Praises of the Lord's Name. (Composition in Suhi by Guru Ram Das Ji)

gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਨਾਉ ਧਰੇ ਵਡਾ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਕਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੋਟਿ ॥
translation_english: If one claims greatness, there is no lack of praises for the Lord. (Composition in Bilaval by Guru Arjan Dev Ji)

translation_english: The One Lord is the Giver of all beings; may I never forget Him. (Composition in Gond by Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji)

translation_english: The mind contemplates the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. (Composition in Ramkali by Bhagat Kabir Ji)

gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
translation_english: One Universal Creator God, The Name Is Truth, Creative Being Personified, No Fear, No Hatred, Image Of The Undying, Beyond Birth, Self-Existent, By Guru's Grace. (Composition in Sri Raag by Bhagat Namdev Ji)
